Several days for the Rotten Blood Quest (base outfit); then minutes if you buy both items on the Market, or several attempts (20 h cooldown per boss and rare drops) if you hunt them yourself

The {wiki:Decaying Defender Outfits|Decaying Defender Outfits} belong to the {wiki:Rotten Blood Quest|Rotten Blood Quest}: you receive the base outfit when you defeat {creature:Bakragore}, at the end of that quest. The first addon is obtained by using a {item:Cursed Wood}, which only the boss {creature:Ichgahal} (Putrefactory) drops; the second addon by using a {item:Darklight Geode}, which only {creature:Chagorz} (Gloom Pillars) drops. Both items can also be bought on the Market. With both addons you earn the achievement **Fully Decayed**.

The {item:Cursed Wood} and the {item:Darklight Geode} are **tradeable** (Market) and no NPC buys or sells them. If you do not want to hunt the bosses, buy them from other players: the effect is the same. You always need the base outfit, though, which requires the Rotten Blood Quest to be complete.
{creature:Ichgahal} and {creature:Chagorz} each have a **20-hour cooldown** and a **15-minute** fight, and both items are **rare** drops. Expect several attempts.

These fights are made for organised teams: the **Paladin** is the main blocker (runs with the boss), the **Knight** holds the {creature:Elder Bloodjaw|Elder Bloodjaws}, and druids/sorcerers attack from range.

Knights: wear the {item:Necklace of the Deep} most of the time because of the heavy Life Drain damage from the Elder Bloodjaws. Paladins: avoid diagonal steps and use {wiki:Powerful Vibrancy|Powerful Vibrancy}, because all the bosses cast {wiki:Paralyse|Paralyse} non-stop.
Killing the same boss again does **not** give you a new taint. The team's taint level is that of the member with the **fewest** taints (see “Taints” below).
1. Base outfit: complete the Rotten Blood Quest

The base outfit is the final reward of the {wiki:Rotten Blood Quest|Rotten Blood Quest}. Here is a summary of the route and what you have to do; for all the details of the four areas and Bakragore, follow that quest's guide. These steps also take you to the Blood Vestibule, where you will hunt for the addon items.

Travel to **Darashia**: by boat ({npc:Petros} links Darashia with Venore, Ankrahmun, Port Hope, Liberty Bay, Yalahar, Issavi, Krailos and Gray Island; to that city's captain say {key:hi}, {key:darashia} and {key:yes} and you arrive at Petros' harbour) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}).

{wiki:Drefia|Drefia} is **west** of Darashia ({coord:33018,32443,7}), on the other side of the mountains that separate Ankrahmun, Darashia, Drefia and Tiquanda. Leave Darashia to the west and use the {item:Rope} to climb the mountain at this spot {coord:33048,32429,7} (or come through the pass between Darashia and Ankrahmun). There are many {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} on the mountain.
Rope spot to climb up to Drefia

In Drefia, talk to {npc:Torkada}: say {key:hi}, {key:expedition}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He tells you that an Inquisition expedition found the entrance to an evil temple, blesses you and lets you into the temple.
Get to the Blood Vestibule entrance

Go to the {spell:Levitate} spot **north-west** of Torkada ({coord:32989,32393,7}) and go up with *exani hur up*. Go past the 2 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, go down the stairs and then go down through the hole. Go down again by the stairs just to the **north-east** and head **south-west** to a door between two limestone pillars. Go through the door: right at the entrance of the {wiki:Blood Vestibule|Blood Vestibule} is {npc:A Bloodshade}.
A Bloodshade, Blood Vestibule entrance (3 floors below the Levitate spot)
Keep the {item:Rope}: you will need it to climb back up through this hole when you leave.
Pay the entry to the blood realm

Talk to {npc:A Bloodshade} ({key:hi}, {key:quest}). To enter the blood realm you must sacrifice **2 {item:Bloody Tears}** or **5,000,000 gp** (choose the gold with {key:detour}). For the tears, use the sacrificial plate twice with them on you (you may need to click several times until they are consumed). After that the pool of blood works as a portal: step into it and you reach the {wiki:Blood Vestibule|Blood Vestibule}, where the Altar is.
Do not step into the pool of blood before making the sacrifice: you take {wiki:Agony Damage|Agony Damage} that removes a percentage of your health.

Inside the Blood Vestibule, talk to {npc:A Bloodshade} again ({key:quest}): you must kill two pairs of evil twins before you reach Bakragore. There are four rooms with {item:Spheric Teleporter|Spheric Teleporters}; each one leads to a hunting area. In each area, the whole team has to fill the **Rotten Charges** counter up to **100** to enter the boss's lever room. You can kill them in any order, but the most common order is the one in the table. Each boss killed gives the team a {wiki:Bakragore's Taints|Bakragore's Taint}, always in the same order.
1st: melee monsters may swap places with you (6%)
2nd: a {creature:Bloodjaw} may spawn from the corpse (6.25%); +1 Elder Bloodjaw in boss fights
3rd: monsters may root you and use a 4th element
4th: you take +14% damage from everything in Rotten Blood

The Putrefactory and Gloom Pillars areas and the fights with Ichgahal and Chagorz are explained in detail in sections 2 and 3; Jaded Roots, the Darklight Core and Bakragore are in the {wiki:Rotten Blood Quest|Rotten Blood Quest} guide. The wiki does not describe the exit from the areas or the boss rooms: after each fight, go back to the spot where the {item:Spheric Teleporter} left you and return that way to the Blood Vestibule (or use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll}).

With the four taints (the four children dead), the team can fight {creature:Bakragore}, in the Blood Vestibule. You have **25 minutes**. The boss fights with four {creature:Elder Bloodjaw|Elder Bloodjaws} and combines his children's mechanics (Mushrooms, Mould trails, Darkfields, Pillars of Dark Energy and the Rotten Charge every 90 seconds). When you defeat him you receive the **base outfit** and permission to make {wiki:Crimson Offering|Crimson Offerings} at the Blood Vestibule altar.
If the team fails the fight, it loses the **last two taints** and the progress of **two random bosses** (the same ones for the whole team). Bakragore has a cooldown of 2 days and 20 hours.
Official artwork of the Decaying Defender Outfits

The wiki does not describe the exit from the Blood Vestibule. Go back to the spot where you arrived through the pool of blood and return that way to {npc:A Bloodshade}'s room in Drefia; if you cannot find the exit, use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} (you go to the temple and no longer need the next step).

From A Bloodshade's room, retrace your steps in reverse: leave through the door between the limestone pillars, head **north-east** to the stairs and go up them, climb up through the hole with the {item:Rope}, go up the stairs and past the Ghouls to the {spell:Levitate} spot, where you go down with *exani hur down*. Then head back **east** over the mountain to the rope spot ({coord:33048,32429,7}) and continue to Darashia, where you take {npc:Petros}' boat or {npc:Chemar}'s carpet.
Levitate spot (go down with exani hur down)
The {item:Cursed Wood} ("This wood has an otherworldly strength and sturdiness.") only drops from {creature:Ichgahal}. Either you buy it on the Market, or you hunt the boss with your team.
Quick option: buy on the Market
Search for **Cursed Wood** on the Market at any depot and buy it. No NPC sells it. If you buy it, skip to the step “Use the Cursed Wood”.
The price is negotiated between players; compare the offers before buying.

If you have already finished the quest, remember that the team's taint level is that of the member with the **fewest** taints, and that each extra taint brings more Elder Bloodjaws and penalties (but also more loot and experience). If you want to clear your taints, talk to {npc:A Bloodshade}: {key:hi}, {key:manage}, then {key:lesser} (only the normal taints) or {key:great} (also Bakragore's final taint) and confirm with {key:yes}.
You can only do this **once every 68 hours**, and it removes **all** taints of that type at once.

Reach the Blood Vestibule as in section 1 (Darashia, Drefia, Levitate spot, A Bloodshade and pool of blood). Inside, enter the room with the {item:Spheric Teleporter} to the {wiki:Putrefactory|Putrefactory} and use it. The monsters here deal **Death**, **Ice** and **Energy** damage (and **Earth** to those with 3+ taints) and are weak to **Holy**, **Earth** and **Fire**. Equip protection against Death, Ice and Earth.

The {wiki:Radicular Totem|Radicular Totems} are indestructible and are in every large room. They cast waves of **4500 Earth damage** that reach very far (even off your screen), clockwise: east, south, west and then north. Each creature that dies near a totem gives it a charge (+10% damage per charge). You can block the waves with {item:Magic Wall Rune|Magic Walls}, but the creatures also break the walls.

The whole team needs **100 Rotten Charges** (the counter with the up arrow next to your name) to enter the boss room. The counter goes up by itself while you are in the hunting area: 1 charge every 20 seconds, full in **33 minutes**. To speed it up, use the area's mechanics:
Use a {item:Lichen Gobbler} on certain tiles on the **lower floor** of the area

{item:Lichen Gobbler|Lichen Gobblers} drop from the Putrefactory monsters themselves ({creature:Oozing Carcass}, {creature:Sopping Carcass}, {creature:Rotten Man-Maggot} and {creature:Meandering Mushroom}).
With everyone's counter at 100, enter the boss's lever room and use the lever to face {creature:Ichgahal}. The fight lasts at most **15 minutes** and the boss has a **20-hour** cooldown.
Ichgahal fights with two {creature:Elder Bloodjaw|Elder Bloodjaws} (more, depending on the team's taints). Equip protection against **Life Drain** and **Death**.

{creature:Ichgahal} leaves trails of **Spores** wherever he goes. In the first stage, touching them deals a little Agony Damage and a *lesser hex*. After a few seconds they turn into **Volatile Funghi**: touching them deals a lot of Agony Damage and a *greater hex* for 15 seconds, and the funghi turns into a **Spore Cloud**, even more dangerous. The boss **heals 13,500 HP** for each Volatile Funghi he steps on and **27,000 HP** for each Spore Cloud, so he must always move onto clean ground. Throughout the fight he summons up to 8 {wiki:Mushroom|Mushrooms} around him, which explode after a while or when you get close (2,500+ Life Drain in a small area).

The Knight uses {spell:Challenge} on all the Elder Bloodjaws and stays in a corner, with a Druid nearby healing him. The room is large: the Paladin runs half a lap on the other side of the room with the boss and the shooters stay out of the Elder Bloodjaws' sight (you avoid the 1st taint's position swaps).
As with {creature:Murcion}: the Paladin runs in a circle with the boss and the Knight runs the full lap with the Elder Bloodjaws, always half a lap behind the Paladin.
He is considered the easiest boss of the quest. His strongest attacks are a Great Death Ring (4,500+), melee (1,600+) and a Physical Ball (1,200+); he also drains mana and paralyses.

Open Ichgahal's body. Besides Crystal Coins, potions and gems, he can drop the {item:Cursed Wood} (a **rare** drop: it did not appear in any of the 29 kills recorded on the wiki). If it does not drop, repeat from the step “Fill the Rotten Charges counter” after the 20-hour cooldown.

The wiki does not describe the exit from Ichgahal's room or from the Putrefactory: after the fight, go back to the spot where the {item:Spheric Teleporter} left you and return that way to the Blood Vestibule (or use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll}). To leave the Blood Vestibule and Drefia, follow the steps “Leave the Blood Vestibule” and “Leave the temple and Drefia” in section 1.
With the base outfit already unlocked, use the {item:Cursed Wood} (right-click → *Use*). You receive the **first addon** of the Decaying Defender Outfits.
Without the base outfit you get the message *"You do not have the base outfit for this addon piece."*.
Addon 1 of the Decaying Defender Outfits
3. Second addon: Darklight Geode (Chagorz, Gloom Pillars)

The {item:Darklight Geode} ("This geode contains some of the rarerest darklight sediments that can be found.") only drops from {creature:Chagorz}. Either you buy it on the Market, or you hunt the boss with your team.
Quick option: buy on the Market
Search for **Darklight Geode** on the Market and buy it. No NPC sells it. If you buy it, skip to the step “Use the Darklight Geode”.

Reach the Blood Vestibule as in section 1 (Darashia, Drefia, Levitate spot, A Bloodshade and pool of blood). Inside, enter the room with the {item:Spheric Teleporter} to the {wiki:Gloom Pillars|Gloom Pillars} and use it. The monsters here deal **Holy**, **Fire** and **Earth** damage (and **Energy** to those with 3+ taints) and are weak to **Physical**, **Death** and **Energy**. Equip protection against Holy, Fire and Earth.

Here you absorb dark energy (a counter of its own next to your name). When it reaches **100**, a painful chain fires from you and jumps to up to **5 nearby targets** (initial range of 3 tiles and jumps of up to 6 tiles), dealing more damage with each jump: if the first target is a Knight or Paladin, 2,250 Energy rising 37% per jump; if it is a Sorcerer or Druid, 900 rising 90% per jump. Keep away from your teammates when your counter is close to 100.
As in the Putrefactory, the whole team needs **100 Rotten Charges** (it goes up by itself, 1 every 20 seconds, full in 33 minutes). To speed it up:
Use a {item:Darklight Obsidian Axe} on the pillars

{item:Darklight Obsidian Axe|Darklight Obsidian Axes} drop from the area's monsters ({creature:Darklight Emitter}, {creature:Darklight Construct}, {creature:Wandering Pillar} and {creature:Converter}).
With everyone's counter at 100, enter the boss's lever room and use the lever to face {creature:Chagorz} (600,000 HP). The fight lasts at most **15 minutes** and the boss has a **20-hour** cooldown.
Chagorz fights with two {creature:Elder Bloodjaw|Elder Bloodjaws} (more, depending on the taints). Equip protection against **Fire** and **Energy**.

During the fight you have a counter next to your name that rises **2 per second** up to **21**. At the maximum, you take **15% of your max health** in Agony Damage per second. Each step you take "drops" a charge on the ground as a {wiki:Darkfield|Darkfield} and lowers the counter by 1. Darkfields last 3 seconds and take **3% of your max health** when you step on them (or per second while you stand on them). In other words, you can take up to 18% per second if you are not careful: keep moving, but do not step on your own trails. Chagorz **heals 375 HP** for each Darkfield he steps on.
Avoid the Pillars of Dark Energy

The boss summons up to 8 {creature:Pillar of Dark Energy|Pillars of Dark Energy}. Each one chains whoever is next to it with **Fire** damage; never stand next to one, let alone several (the chains add up into huge damage spikes). Whoever gets chained gains another counter (max. 11) that drops by 1 per second and deals about **1,200 Fire** on each tick.
Chagorz's beam triggers **all** the charges of that counter at once. If you have many, move away from the front of the boss.
Use the Rotten Charge to your advantage

Every **90 seconds** Chagorz drops a **Rotten Charge** in the centre of the room, which lasts 15 seconds. **If no Elder Bloodjaw steps on it**: the room warns at 6 seconds (*"The rotten charge is going to explode!"*) and at 10 seconds (*"THE ROTTEN CHARGE WILL EXPLODE SOON!"*), and at 15 seconds it explodes and each player loses **40% of their max health**. **If an Elder Bloodjaw steps on it**, for 15 seconds: those nearby do not drop Darkfields, the boss does not heal on the fields, the Elder Bloodjaws leave the room and the boss's resistances drop considerably. In return, the boss prepares a devastating strike on the current target at 6 and 12 seconds.

The boss shouts *"WILL ... PUNISH ... YOU!"* at the start of the mechanic and again after the 1st strike, and *"RAAAR!"* on the 2nd strike. That is why the Knight should be the target during these 12 seconds.

The most common strategy: the **Paladin** runs in circles with the boss in the **northern** part of the room, while the shooters split between the **west** and **east** sides. The **Knight** takes the Elder Bloodjaws and runs in circles in the **southern** part. When the Rotten Charge appears, the Knight brings the Bloodjaws onto it and then pulls the boss to tank the two strikes. Then the Paladin takes the boss again and everything repeats until Chagorz dies.

Open Chagorz's body. Besides Crystal Coins, potions and gems, he can drop the {item:Darklight Geode} (a **rare** drop: it did not appear in any of the 22 kills recorded on the wiki). If it does not drop, repeat from the step “Fill the Rotten Charges counter” after the 20-hour cooldown.

The wiki does not describe the exit from Chagorz's room or from the Gloom Pillars: after the fight, go back to the spot where the {item:Spheric Teleporter} left you and return that way to the Blood Vestibule (or use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll}). To leave the Blood Vestibule and Drefia, follow the steps “Leave the Blood Vestibule” and “Leave the temple and Drefia” in section 1.

With the base outfit unlocked, use the {item:Darklight Geode}. You receive the **second addon**. Once you have used both items (Cursed Wood and Darklight Geode), you earn the **Fully Decayed** achievement.
Without the base outfit you get the message *"You do not have the base outfit for this addon piece."*.
Addon 2 of the Decaying Defender Outfits and the Fully Decayed achievement (with both addons)

Addon summary: the **first addon** comes from the {item:Cursed Wood} (only dropped by {creature:Ichgahal}, in the Putrefactory) and the **second addon** from the {item:Darklight Geode} (only dropped by {creature:Chagorz}, in the Gloom Pillars). Both can be bought and sold on the Market.
**Fully Decayed** achievement (2 points): "You defeated the embodiments of decay and live to tell the tale, wear the rotting attire of the unfaltering defender proudly."

**Taints:** you get one taint for each of Bakragore's children that you kill for the first time; repeating the same boss does not give another. To gain a taint in a fight you must have the same number of taints as the team member with the fewest, not yet have that boss's taint and deal damage to the boss. Normal taints disappear when you defeat Bakragore, when the team fails the fight against him (it loses the last two) or when you remove them with {npc:A Bloodshade} (once every 68 hours).

**Final taint:** when you kill Bakragore you get the final taint (+4.5% experience and more loot, like a normal taint, but with no penalties on its own). If the whole team has it, Bakragore's children can drop their essences. Normal taints on top of the final taint increase the penalties (more position swaps, more Bloodjaws, fear and +21% damage taken).
The more taints the team has, the more {creature:Elder Bloodjaw|Elder Bloodjaws} appear in the fights with Ichgahal and Chagorz (up to 5).
